archetypes.name: dyn-prune-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Ledger compatibility and normalization now affect pruning history.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the prune ledger normalization and history parsing paths. Focus on legacy seven-column rows, new weighted columns, malformed-row fail-open behavior, duplicate round merges, and rewrite/ensure preservation semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-prune-weighting
archetypes.rationale: The prune decision now consumes value-weighted accepted findings.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the weighted prune decision path from classification TSV rows through reviewer_prune_filter. Check that scope-aware voter severities drive only the net prune gate, body_severity is ignored, rejected and total counts are unchanged, and the unweighted acceptance floor remains intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
